_decision: darkSurface = oklch(0.205 0 0). the rail column's own surface. The value comes from proposedDarkRailTokens — the approved decision record — NOT from measuring the component and writing down what it happened to say. If this check fails, that is the finding.
_serialisation: The expected string is the COMPUTED spelling. tokens.css authors some colours as oklch(55.6% 0 0) while the browser computes oklch(0.556 0 0) — the same colour, and compare() is exact string equality. proposedDarkRailTokens already uses the computed spelling, so the value is copied unchanged. Never resolve a mismatch by pasting the measured value.
_scope: Bounded on both sides: above --background or the rail vanishes into the page, below darkHoverBg or hover has nowhere to go. The anchor is F-1 — an anchor names an ELEMENT, not a divergence, and F-1 is this same column's width. Sharing it is intended.
